title: 第17章 臣服值第18章 挑选
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
多用了一日时间巩固修为后，朔衡再次离开了太初峰。
他抬手招来一只高大雪白的仙鹤，翻身坐上去。
这是洺万里专门为他寻来的代步工具。
太初峰很高，下山的路很陡。
寻常人上山，大多选择飞上来。
但朔衡没有筑基，不会飞，所以只能用这种偷懒的法子。
【小四，你有没有定位功能？】
【宿主，我可以定位与您有过接触的气运之子所在，不过其距离您的位置不能太远，否则无法检测。】
【那现在检测一下他们四个都在哪儿吧。】
【好的，宿主。】
下一秒，朔衡眼前铺开一张地图光幕。
四个金色圆点分布在地图上，朔衡认真的看了一眼。
朔千夜在主峰，陈尘在望月峰，陆纵横在暗香峰，林未醒在外门。
嗯。
这个结果并不让朔衡感到意外。
凭借陈尘和陆纵横展现出来的圣灵根天赋，想要成为一峰亲传不难。
至于林未醒，这小子都七岁了还在发育，被丢去外门已经是最好的结果了。
【宿主，您要去找气运之子吗？】
【当然去。】
毕竟是任务相关的事，朔衡还算上心。

况且，他也需要测试一下“臣服值”的获取方式。
不如……就从林未醒开始？
——
“走一走看一看，从秘境摘来的灵药喽！还都是新鲜的！”
“两位师兄师姐，要不要来一块同心玉锁？锁住就是一辈子！”
“号外号外，刚出炉的二品丹药，价格实惠，先到先得！”
享悦街依旧繁华，无数仙门弟子穿行其中，言笑晏晏，神采飞扬。
而在这些心情愉悦的弟子中，有一道幼小的身影站的笔直，粗布铺地的小摊上，却无一人光顾。
忽然，林未醒发现自己的摊位前多了一小团阴影。
紫色长袍披身，白玉发冠精致夺目。
明明是六岁孩童，神色却全然没有身为幼童的稚嫩和迷惘。
“这冰晶灵果怎么卖？”
林未醒骤然回神，看着眼前好像从头到脚都在发着光的小少年，脱口而出的话都变得磕磕巴巴：“三……三……”
content_en:
After spending an extra day consolidating his cultivation, Shuo Heng left Taichu Peak again.
He raised his hand to summon a tall, snow-white crane, turned over and sat on it.
This is the means of transportation that Ming Wanli found specially for him.
Taichu Peak is very high and the way down is very steep.
When ordinary people go up the mountain, most of them choose to fly up.
But Shuoheng didn't have a foundation and couldn't fly, so he could only use this lazy method.
[Xiaosi, do you have positioning function? 】
[Host, I can locate the Son of Luck who has been in contact with you, but it cannot be too far from your location, otherwise it cannot be detected. 】
[Then let’s check where the four of them are now. 】
[Okay, host. 】
The next second, a map light curtain spread out in front of Shuo Heng's eyes.
Four golden dots were distributed on the map, and Shuo Heng took a serious look.
Shuo Qianye was at the main peak, Chen Chen was at Wangyue Peak, Lu Zongheng was at Anxiang Peak, and Lin Weixing was at the outer gate.
Um.
This result did not surprise Shuo Heng.
With the Holy Spirit root talents displayed by Chen Chen and Lu Zongheng, it is not difficult to become a direct disciple of Yifeng.
As for Lin Weixing, this kid is seven years old and still growing, so being thrown out of the outer gate is the best outcome.
[Host, are you going to find the Son of Luck? 】
【Of course. 】
After all, it was a mission-related matter, so Shuo Heng took it seriously.
Moreover, he also needs to test the method of obtaining "submission value".
Why not... just start with Lin Weixing?
——
"Take a walk and take a look at the elixirs picked from the secret realm! They are all fresh!"
"Two senior brothers and sisters, would you like a jade lock of the same heart? Lock it for a lifetime!"
"No, no, no, the second-grade elixir has just been released, the price is affordable, first come, first served!"
Xiangyue Street is still bustling, with countless Immortal Sect disciples walking through it, talking, laughing and in high spirits.
Among these happy disciples, there was a young figure standing upright, but no one came to the stall covered with coarse cloth.
Suddenly, Lin Weixing found a small shadow in front of his stall.
Wearing a purple robe, the white jade hair crown is exquisite and eye-catching.
He was obviously a six-year-old child, but his expression did not have the immaturity and confusion of a toddler at all.
"How to sell this ice crystal spirit fruit?"
Lin Weixing suddenly came back to his senses. Looking at the young boy who seemed to be glowing from head to toe in front of him, the words he blurted out became awkward: "Three...three..."
